title: Reported military clash with aliens at Dulce

tellings.quote: uh Leonard Stringfield talked to me about it and he said he'd heard three different versions.

plain: US military forces are said to have fought with aliens at Dulce, New Mexico, sometime between 1977 and 1979. John Brandenburg, a scientist who argues that life on Mars was wiped out by nuclear war, says the UFO researcher Leonard Stringfield talked to him about it and told him he had heard three different versions of the story. Beyond that, neither man says what happened.
